description: This file defines the ViewLeaveEntitlementController class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for handling the leave entitlement view by creating Vue components and adding relevant data props based on HTTP request parameters. It integrates multiple traits for user roles, employee data, leave types, and leave periods, and manages access control and data provisioning for leave entitlement views.

classes.name: ViewLeaveEntitlementController
classes.description: A controller class that handles rendering of leave entitlement views, managing data fetching, permission checks, and Vue component setup based on request query parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the leave entitlement view component by setting properties such as employee data, leave type, leave period, and permissions, based on provided request parameters.

methods.name: addLeaveTypeProp
methods.description: Adds leave type data to the Vue component if leaveTypeId is specified in the request.

methods.name: addLeavePeriodProp
methods.description: Adds leave period data to the Vue component, either based on start and end date request parameters or defaults to current leave period.
